ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; low-intensity pixels dominate the medial region, while high-intensity pixels dominate the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large, contiguous low-intensity black region occupies the medial surface from the peduncle to approximately 65% of the horizontal span. Distal lobes exhibit high-intensity white backgrounds with dense, irregular black mottling and stippling patterns concentrated along the interior pigment boundaries and lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, wide U-shaped notch; interior angle estimated at 145 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 5% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medial trailing edge is relatively smooth; distal trailing edges exhibit irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-6 pixels, most prominent on the right lobe distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips, forming an open, wide-angle 'V' silhouette against the background.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single circular high-contrast mark located in the lower-central medial black region; multiple dark punctate clusters localized on the white distal surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three parallel diagonal dark linear disruptions (rake marks) on the left distal lobe; one distinct horizontal white linear scratch localized in the right medial black zone.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Set of three parallel diagonal rake marks on the left distal lobe and a single prominent white linear abrasion on the right medial black region.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular 'feathered' transition zone between black and white pigmentation regions, characterized by intense black-on-white stippling.
